analyzed_vuln.description: RWMol::replaceAtom() copies the replacement atom and deletes the old graph atom, but does not update or clear entries in d_atomBookmarks that point to the old Atom (the source even has a `FIX: do something about bookmarks` comment). V2000 parsing bookmarks each input atom by its 1-based atom number. ParseMarvinSmartsLine() can replace a non-query atom with a QueryAtom, leaving that numbered bookmark dangling. A later SGroup SPA entry resolves the dangling bookmark in SubstanceGroup::addParentAtomWithBookmark(), and Atom::getIdx() reads the freed object, causing the heap-use-after-free. The fix belongs in replaceAtom(): preserve bookmark semantics while replacing every bookmark reference to the old pointer with the new atom pointer before deleting the old atom.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A V2000 mol block must create at least one atom (which ParseMolBlockAtoms bookmarks using its 1-based file atom number), then include a valid `M  MRV SMA` property for that same atom whose SMARTS parses successfully and whose current atom has no query, causing ParseMarvinSmartsLine() to call replaceAtom(). Before property parsing ends, an existing SGroup (introduced by an `M  STY` line) must be referenced by an `M  SPA` vector line containing that same atom bookmark. ParseSGroupV2000VectorDataLine passes the bookmark to addParentAtomWithBookmark(); getUniqueAtomWithBookmark returns the stale pointer and getIdx dereferences it. An SAL membership entry is not required to reach the invalid read because getIdx occurs before the parent-membership check.

args: Inspect RDKit bookmark container semantics and mutation patterns. In rdkit/Code/GraphMol/RWMol.cpp, how should RWMol::replaceAtom update every entry in d_atomBookmarks that equals the old Atom pointer? Identify the exact container type from rdkit/Code/GraphMol/ROMol.h, whether duplicate pointers under a bookmark are meaningful, and any analogous implementation for replacing bond bookmarks.

The reported ASan issue is a heap-use-after-free: RWMol::replaceAtom() installs a copied replacement Atom in the graph and deletes the original but leaves d_atomBookmarks entries pointing to the original. V2000 atom-number bookmarks later resolve through an SGroup SPA and call getIdx() on freed memory. The desired root fix is to preserve bookmark identity by replacing every old pointer in all bookmark vectors with the newly installed atom before deletion, including multiple marks and repeated references. I am currently inspecting rdkit/Code/GraphMol/RWMol.cpp, rdkit/Code/GraphMol/ROMol.h, and rdkit/Code/GraphMol/ROMol.cpp and want confirmation of container/API conventions and analogous code.
